name: docs-governance
description: Modular documentation governance: micro-core protocol with pluggable domain profiles.

protocol_history.summary: Streamline Product Validation profile to dual-tier model (acceptance.md and testing.md), converging scenarios and edge cases into acceptance scenario matrices and test fixtures.

Modular Governance Architecture: micro-core protocol (routing, style, checklists, common patterns, intake SOP) decoupled from pluggable domain profiles (validation, architecture, operations); contract-driven assembly via contracts.md.
Product validation standard: acceptance.md (journeys), experience_scenarios.md (experiences), and testing.md (implementation) three-tier model.

Three routing gates (time, audience, cognitive mode) with root-files exception; repository contracts split from adoption; knowledge-layers page; postmortem workflow in update/review checklists; manifest for drift detection.
Flat Diataxis decision list, adoption held repository contracts, common-docs pattern library, AGENTS.md maintainer rule.

update_policy: Semantic versioning on protocol_version. MAJOR: a repository following the old protocol would be non-compliant without migration work. MINOR: new optional profiles or non-breaking additions; old content stays valid. PATCH: clarifications and typo-level changes that do not alter any rule.

core.description: Universal meta-governance protocol (routing, style, checklists, common patterns, intake SOP)

validation.description: Product validation standard: acceptance and testing

architecture.description: Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and decision lifecycle

roles.guide: Governance prose; must match standard byte for byte.
roles.checklist: Review and update procedures; must match standard byte for byte.
roles.guard: Maintainer and AI policy; must match standard byte for byte.
roles.library: Reusable document patterns; must match standard byte for byte.
roles.pattern: Domain pattern specification; must match standard byte for byte.
